international.title: Car use in London forecast to rise by 10% in next decade
international.summary: Modelling in draft of 10-year London plan threatens Sadiq Khan’s promises on improving air quality Car use in London will rise by 10% over the next decade with cycling and walking falling as a proportion of trips, according to an official forecast by the city’s mayoralty, putting into doubt Sadiq Khan’s promises on air quality and the environment. Based on projections in the draft version of the latest 10-year London plan , drawn up by the mayor’s office and Transport for London (TfL), road congestion from a growing population would slow buses down, while packed tube services might require stations to close regularly to ease numbers.
